Class BotControlLeaseManager

java.lang.Object
com.soulfiremc.server.bot.BotControlLeaseManager
public final class BotControlLeaseManager extends Object
Coordinates exclusive SDK control of bots without coupling a lease to one transient Minecraft connection.
